content.text:
I wrote `Label: Business` to `/work/answer.txt`. It is an estimate, not an exact count.

The file has no labels on the articles, so I couldn't count them directly. I classified all 341 articles with keyword matching for each of the four topics. 84 of them matched no keywords. I read those 84 by eye and assigned each one a rough category in my head.

Combining the two passes gave roughly these totals: World about 108, Sci/Tech about 86, Sports about 79 and Business about 67. Business came out lowest, but Sports and Business are fairly close, and the keyword matching can misplace articles.
